Extract her Slack username, email address, and the necessary channels specified in that message. Usernames start with a capital letter. Resolve channel names against the available channels and return their exact tool identifiers. Do not invent a username, email address, or channel assignment. If the relevant message or required details cannot be identified unambiguously, raise NotEnoughInformationError.
